apps.name: My Apps
apps.description: Installs and updates all of iSharpe's phone apps, including itself.
apps.releaseNotes: Updates to your apps now install without asking each time, and new versions show up right away.

apps.name: Sharp
apps.description: A clean home screen: the apps you pick, then one A–Z list of everything with a letter strip to jump through it.
apps.releaseNotes: New: a Recent folder with your most recently used apps that aren't already on the home screen (1 to 10, set in Settings). Optional Usage access makes it include apps opened from notifications and links too.

apps.name: Weather Line
apps.description: Weather in one line: a home-screen widget with today's high, low and chance of rain, shaded for sunrise and sunset.
apps.releaseNotes: New look: high, low and rain chance at one end (left or right, your choice), then the day as a chart: temperature line, hourly rain bars, hour labels, lavender night and light blue daytime.
